notes.title: Update 1.35.1
notes.content:
[h2]Umbra Legio: Chapter II[/h2]
You’ve successfully established your secret organization and are now ready to use it to silently operate across the territory. It’s time to venture into the Umbra Legio Bronze Age, unlocking new missions, champions, gear, and levels. Explore the Castrum, Hollowstone, and Deep Roads areas to uncover their secrets.

[h2]Horse & Stables[/h2]
A new building is now available for construction: Stables. The Stables unlock the ability to summon a Horse using a special flute almost anywhere (except in the Villa). The Horse acts as mobile storage, allowing you to store almost everything. While it does not automatically withdraw resources outside of safe locations, you can summon it and manually access stored items.

Additionally, you will be able to use Oats as an alternative method to travel across the world using Traveling Stations. However, please note that this is intended as an optional feature.

New items required to construct the Stables and upgrade the Horse’s storage capacity can be found in Weighted Chests (available in both Hollowstone Mine and Blightstone Marshes).

[h2]Ironclaw Mine - Coal Floor[/h2]
From now on, there is a possibility that Ironclaw Mine may spawn a Hidden Hatch, leading to a sublevel where you can find additional veins of coal. Please note that the spawn chance is not 100%.

[h2]Other Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Significant balance changes have been made to Campaign Missions 6–10 of Umbra Legio.
[*] Fixed an issue with missing blueprints for Farm II and Weapon Workbench VII.
[*] Major balance update implemented for the early game.
[/list]

notes.title: Mausoleum Fatum Obscura
notes.content:
[h1]Update 1.34.0 is now available![/h1]

[h2]Umbra Legio [/h2]

Reestablish the secret organization to aid you in your journey against deserters and savages. Equip your army with unique items to progress through the campaign. Note that Umbra Legio will be available after completing the chapter Siege of Perusia.

[h2]Mausoleum Fatum Obscura[/h2]

Venture into a unique dungeon with three bosses located near the 13th Legion Camp to stop the upcoming threat and discover the source of the savages’ knowledge. Unlock secrets to craft legendary equipment and powerful artifacts.

Please note that Stygian Iron is limited to approximately 20 pieces, so you will only be able to craft one artifact for now. Choose carefully.

[previewyoutube=BeBGbz-i0HQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2] Other Improvements[/h2]

[list]
[*] Additional buildings have been added to the 13th Legion Quartermaster’s stock.
[*] Some consumable items will now leave behind a used item that was part of the crafting process (e.g., if you drink an Elixir, you receive an Empty Vial).
[*] From now on, all equipped items will not be considered for crafting. This means that to use an item for crafting, you must unequip it first.
[*] All Combatant Notes are now stackable up to 99, helping to keep the quest items list clean.
[*] The Lost Bulla is no longer required to cast the Protect the Innocent ability. You can unequip and remove it.
[*] Fixed an issue with the Trader’s list of currencies. Now, only the intended currencies are displayed.
[*] Fixed an incorrect note under gatherable resources.
[*] Fixed a critical issue that caused the game to crash repeatedly after upgrading storage to the final level.
[/list]

[h2]Known Issues[/h2]

[list]
[*] Legendary Bow has incorrect damage (higher than supposed to be). With next update it will be lower, so be warned about that.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.33
notes.content:
[h1]infiltration: Forges of Stalkers[/h1]

Venture into the new Infiltration Mission to uncover the secret behind the creation of the deadly stalkers. This mission will take you to a savage den hidden beneath the mountains.

Please note that the new Infiltration will be rotated with the first one, meaning that when entering the infiltration, you will not always encounter the forges.

 [h1]Player Corpses & Storages[/h1]

We have added a decay timer to players' corpses. This means that approximately 24 hours after a gladiator dies, their body, along with all the items inside, will be removed from the world, with no option to retrieve them.

Players who already have a corpse will get a 24-hour timer upon their first after-update app launch.

Please note that with this change, dying will also override the items inside the corpse. This means that if your character dies in battle and the previous body wasn't cleared, the previous corpse and its items will be lost forever.

As compensation, we've added additional levels for all storages (including the Resource Bank, but excluding the Consumables Storages), though it will cost some resources from the 13th Legion's Chapter.

 [h1]Battle Pass Refreshments[/h1]

To keep the rewards in the Battle Pass lineup relevant, we've refreshed the season with some changes in rewards. These adjustments will align with your current level of progression, meaning they will provide Tier 4 resources and weapons.

The new season will start a day after the full-version rollout.

 [h1]Other Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added new Knowledges to the Hollowstone Mine that will increase the amount of Oil gathered by the Trading Post.
[*] Upgrading the Miner's Table in Hollowstone Mine will reduce the gold cost of refining with each level.
[*] Added a new Locksmith at the 13th Legion's Camp.
[*] Venom's Medicine can now be stored in Alchemy Storage.
[*] Reduced the prosperity requirement for the Scheme Trader's post from 12 to 10.
[*] Energy costs of Repairs have been reverted to what they were before patch 1.32.
[*] Fixed an issue where some enemy corpses disappeared, preventing players from getting rewards.
[*] Fixed an issue related to Boar's Eye drop.
[*] Fixed incorrect amounts and recipe links in Tier 4 recipes.
[*] Fixed incorrect disassemble recipes for some low-tier items.
[*] Fixed localization issues that prevented some players from resetting their game progress.
[/list]

[h1]IMPORTANT[/h1]
With this patch, we've updated the game engine version, which may cause some performance regressions in very specific cases. If you encounter any issues related to loading speed, delays in window opening or frame drops, please contact us—we will try to find a solution as soon as possible.

notes.title: Questions and Answers session results!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello Brave Gladiators![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43726807/64023fdafd585231d00d8c852216885e519344b5.jpg[/img]

A few days ago we launched a big Question and Answers session, and here is the most upvoted questions we got from different social platforms with the comments and answers from the developer team.

[b]Q: Can Perusia be more useful?[/b]
A: Yes, we have some ideas and plans for revamping the Perusia region, making it more complex in terms of both story and game mechanics. One of the ideas (no promises that it will come to life) is to create a personal Prosperity system for Perusia - with its own Tax Collector and buildings to construct.

[b]Q: I hope there will be advertising where you can earn diamonds[/b]
A: There is the Mysterious Chest that can provide some gems for the Ads Watch. We don't plan to add more options for now.

[b]Q: When new story mood coming out. Are there any other locations after the hollowstone mine? [/b]
A: For now, the Hollowstone Mine questline involves preparations for marching out to Blightstone Marshes. We are eager to introduce the continuation of the story, featuring new locations to explore, enemies to defeat, resources to gather, equipment to craft, mysteries to solve, and drama to experience. Our plans for the first quarter of 2024 are to introduce the Blightstone Marshes Act into the game.

[b]Q: Add Guild events, buildings, meetups.[/b]
A: Guild mechanics are something we really want to explore, although we can't promise to deliver something significant in the first half of the next year. 

[b]Q: I hope there is a function that allows character clothes to be shaped like custom clothes.[/b]
A: We really love the idea and understand its origin. Many players have a collection of outdated items with a low power score but a unique visual appearance. Although allowing players to choose their visual appearance is a cool idea, it can undermine visual expectations. For example, if you encounter a player who looks like a leather newbie but actually has Combatant Gear underneath, it can be very confusing. Therefore, we can't make promises at this point, but the idea has crossed our minds.

[b]Q: I suggest that you add the option of group play in the league or a challenge that combines one league with another league.[/b]
A: Group content, such as dungeons, that genuinely offers multiplayer activities is something we aspire to incorporate into our game in the distant future. However, it will require significant changes in the way players interact with each other—introducing roles, classes, and abilities to make group gameplay truly engaging. While the concept is consistently on our minds, there are no plans to introduce it in 2024.

[b]Q: Will you continue the story across the bridge where you entered the villa? [/b]
A: The bridge is the path from which our character came, and who knows, maybe one day we will revisit this area.

[b]Q: The ability to trade with other members of your tribe would be nice.[/b]
A: Trading or exchanging goods with guild members is not something we want to see in the game. However, having certain items accessible only to guild members, obtainable through special coins or by participating in guild activities, would be a nice addition.


[b]Q: One thing well two, first the auto harvest feature in the lower left should also allow us to auto craft the number of items we wish to make.[/b]
A: Auto-mode improvements are something we want to explore in the near future. Allowing players to disassemble items, collect loot from craft stations, or focus on gathering resources instead of chasing enemies is something we aspire to achieve.

[b]Q: Hey, are u still planning to go on with ur idea “pets” from be4? I would love to see something like that implemented.[/b]
A: We still have it on the list of future plans, but there's nothing specific in the first half of the next year. Although we would love to see our Gladiators with mighty bears or lions fighting alongside them in the glorious battles to come.

[b]Q: Will you be including a global chat feature?[/b]
A: Interesting Idea, but no plans for that in the closest future.

[b]Q: I would like to see a new equipment storage method where weapons and armor can be put on display instead of in a warehouse.[/b]
A: A mannequin or weapon display are indeed interesting ideas. Something we will definitely look into in the future. But first, we need to add more options just to store armor. Perhaps additional equipment storage?

[b]Q: Is there any plan of adding disassembly work table and repair in Ertuscan tombs? Is there any chance of a workshop to merge the existing weapns/armours to higher tiers?[/b]
A: The Etruscan Tomb is something we want to change in the near future, and yes, there are ideas for creating safe zones with options to replenish supplies, repair gear, and disassemble items. There is an answer regarding merging in the question below.

[b]Q: Will you add the ability to view the equipment of guild members?[/b]
A: The idea of checking the guildmates' gear or even visiting their villa is indeed something great. We have some thoughts about that, but it will not come to life in the first quarter of 2024.

[b]Q: Will you add an option to merge equipment to higher grade (outside events) and to be able to re-roll their stats?[/b]
A. No plans for that, sorry. 'Merge' is something experimental that we introduced in the recent events, but it's something we want to keep exclusively in that context.

[b]Q: Will there be things within the guild in the future? (Guild Race with Leaderboard, Guild co-op zone building.[/b]
A: We still have plans for those, but not in the near future.

[b]Q: Will there be an option to change the attributes (Critical Chance, Bonus Damage, Block Chance...) of a weapon/armor?[/b]
A: Reforging is a highly desirable yet conflicting mechanic. Although it offers options for players to focus on their chosen build as a favorite, in 99% of cases, players tend to select the most powerful attributes and completely ignore the others. While it is something we want to introduce, if it ever comes to fruition, it will likely have some downsides—such as "lower" options than could be obtained through crafting or limited attempts to reforge, and so on.

notes.content:
[h2]Battle Pass: Season 4[/h2]


A new season of the Battle Pass is kicking off, introducing significant changes in terms of balance and rewards. General As a unique reward, players will have the opportunity to obtain a Velite set, significantly boosting combat performance.
Note that the Gold Chest at the end of the pass may contain season equipment of both uncommon and rare quality.
In Addition the total number of points required to complete the Season 4 has been significantly decreased along with changes to quest rewards and difficulty.


[h2]Protect the Innocent[/h2]

The character now possesses a new ability that enables them to go on a rampage, increasing combat potential while reducing health restoration and armor.
To activate it, players need to deal a certain amount of damage or defeat several enemies. The charge resets when traveling between locations.
This ability is fueled by a unique item called Bulla. New players will receive it upon completing introductory quests. Players who have completed the initial stages earlier - Bulla will be waiting near the mailbox.

[h2]Traders[/h2]

A new addition to the game is the Trader entity. Through trading, players can quickly and conveniently exchange or purchase various resources. It's important to note that traders have their own specific time frames for updating their assortment.


[h2]Dungeon Reset[/h2]

The Tomb and the Cursed Grotto no longer require an entrance fee and are accessible within six hours of the initial entry. Coins previously required to enter the Grotto can be disassembled at the disassembly station.
The Tombs of Vengeful Wraiths and Noxious Fumes now reset at certain intervals but remain available for a short period.

[h2]Travel More[/h2]

Fast Traveling is now available for instant access to resettable locations and dungeons, including the following locations:

* Hunting Grounds
* Stone Quarry
* Pine Forest
* Cursed Grotto
* Etruscan Tomb

[h2]Stone Quarry[/h2]

This location is now resettable, similar to Pine Forest and Hunting Grounds. It has been reduced in size to allow players to quickly gather the required amount of stone. Please note that leaving older version of this zone will make it (older version) unavailable. Character corpses on older version of this location will be permanently lost upon exit.

[h2]Expeditions[/h2]


[i]The new operational process follows these steps:[/i]

* Miners begin excavation work, signaling an icon like event.
*  During this phase, players can teleport to the entrance using a Transit Pass.
* A push notification is sent shortly before the passage opens.
* The expedition enters the opening phase. Direct teleportation to the entrance during this phase will require gem payment. However, players can still manually teleport via the fast travel window using a transit pass, limited to the flag at the mine entrance.


[h2]New Warrior Talents[/h2]

The Warrior path introduces new talents:

* Weapon Specialization (one-handed/two-handed)
* Double Shot (sling/bow)

[h2]Storages[/h2]

Players can utilize resources from any storage in peaceful locations for crafting items. Priority order for resource retrieval is as follows:
1. Player's inventory
2. Mailbox
3. General storage
4. Chest storage
Accessible storage locations include: Villa, Colosseum Outskirts, Hollowstone Mine, Old Mine (Copper Mine)

[h2]Other Improvements[/h2]

* Updated and added new sound effects.
*  New animations for Wolf Animals.
* Fixed the issue of a stuck item tooltip.
* Adjusted difficulty of Boars in Pine Forest
* Added descriptions to the Mystic Cauldron window.
* Added markers to resettable locations and dungeons.
* Rectified missing text on Weighted Chest.
* Changed the operating principle of the Snares; now, after collecting meat, the trap relocates on the location with a respawn time.
* Reduced the attack range of ranged enemies; they can only target within the screen.
* Advertising rewards are now available on Google PC and Android Emulators.
* Basic buildings now only require gold and time, not resources, to be built.

notes.title: Update 1.28.0: Battle pass & Alchemy
notes.content:
[b]Battle Pass: Season 3[/b]

Welcome to the new season of the Battle Pass launching this month. With this month's theme, alongside balance tweaks and numerous enhancements, you can mine the Ethereal Guide armor set.
The keys in the Battle Pass rewards have been replaced by treasure chests, which you can open from your inventory. The treasure chests in your villa will remain for the time being for those who haven't used all their keys from previous seasons.
Note: A Halloween event with extra rewards will launch later this month.


[b]Auto-Mode [/b]

All locations now default to Auto-Mode settings for searching and gathering within a small radius, as before. Additionally, the small radius applies to the Villa, ensuring characters don't continuously gather Water or Clay.
The enhanced algorithm (with a larger radius) will feature in the following areas: Hunting Grounds, Pine Forest, All Hollowstone Locations, Colosseum, and Etruscan Tomb.
Within the Colosseum, the target selection radius is increased, enabling Auto-Mode to focus on ranged foes. Plus, browsing your inventory during Auto-Mode is back.

[b]Alchemy [/b]

Potions are now categorized into short-term (Combat) and long-term (Elixirs) effects. Elixirs offer a lasting boost, while Combat potions provide a powerful but brief effect. These effects won't overlap but will supersede previous ones.
New potions boosting armor, critical damage, and gathering speed will debut.
Brewing potions will need world-found ingredients. Nucretius will trade empty vials for Colosseum coins and provide the Philosopher's Stone to merge two potions into a potent variant. Use the Mystic Cauldron near Nucretius for these combinations.

[b]Food and Cooking[/b]

Starting with Mushroom Soup, eating cooked food not only restores stamina but also temporarily increases your maximum stamina. This stamina boost stacks with different food types but replaces the same food type's buff. Additionally, you can now use Raw Meat for stamina restoration while out in the fields; however, please note that it cannot be stored in the resource warehouse.
Cooking is simplified, demanding just one culture point and an extra ingredient, and the Burned Clay Bowl has been reintroduced. Moreover, dishes like porridge will slightly enhance stamina restoration.

[b]Locations[/b]

Forests that reset upon entry, e.g., Hunting Grounds and Pine Forest, have undergone several modifications.
The overall number of enemies has been decreased, and some will now launch ambush attacks on the player. This is done to enhance the exploration experience of these locations, infusing them with more dynamics and combat scenarios.
The Tunnels of the Hollowstone Mine remain unchanged.

- Updated the visuals for destroying veins in the Hollowstone Mine.
- Fixed the Movement and Attack Speed information on the stat panel.

- Resolved the issue with non-activating workers in the Battle Pass rewards.

- Reduced the amount of energy required to destroy barricades in the Hunting Grounds.
- Increased the duration of time that enemies pursue the character.

notes.title: Stamina Food re-design announcement
notes.content:
[h3]Khaire, gladiators![/h3]

A few days ago we alerted you to the planned nerf of the Attack Power stat. After engaging in discussions with players (thank you for your feedback) in the Discord and Facebook community, we have decided to cancel the proposed change and retain the indicator's impact on damage without reducing it. As an accompanying measure, we will decrease the potential values on items, but this change will solely affect newly crafted items.

Furthermore, there is something we've been eager to modify for some time - the evolution of food efficiency over time. Therefore, we will be implementing a few alterations to cooking in an upcoming update:
Cooked food, starting with Mushroom Soup, will now not only restore stamina but also increase the maximum stamina value for a few hours.
The bonus to maximum stamina from food will be stackable (e.g., Soup + Porridge). However, food of the same type will replace the existing buff, renewing its duration. The exception will be food from events (like Caramelized Apple), which will provide a universal bonus of +10.
Preparing food will be slightly more straightforward, requiring only 1 culture and an additional ingredient. The recipe will include the Burned Clay Bowl, again. We understand that the bowl is not the easiest item to obtain, but we are considering potential improvements to balance this aspect.
We will enable the consumption of Raw Meat. This solution has both advantages and disadvantages. The positive aspect is that it will be possible to restore stamina right in the fields. The downside is apparent - if meat is transformed into food, it cannot be stored in the resource warehouse; it will move to the food warehouse. Please note that we do not intend to move it automatically, but if you withdraw it from storage, you will not be able to return it.
Lastly, but certainly not least, all food items, starting with porridge, will receive a slight bonus to stamina restoration value.

Please share your thoughts in the comments.

P.S. Some details (such as food restoration values) may be subject to change during development.

notes.title: Important Attack Power parameter changes
notes.content:
[h3]Khaire, gladiators![/h3]

We have detected a bug with the Attack Power stat. The problem is that its formula assumes the growth of all damage by 1% for every 100 points. This means the growth was assumed to be not very strongly correlated with the "Additional Damage" stat. Unfortunately, [b]due to a bug, Attack Power does not work correctly[/b], overestimating the damage and making the content too easy to pass where it was not intended.

Considering the options to solve the problem, we have come to the conclusion that [b]this indicator will be tuned down to its original values[/b]. Otherwise, we would have to increase the health and damage of all enemies in the game.

Players who focus on this stat should expect a rather noticeable decrease in weapon damage.
We are also thinking about compensation in the form of the ability to create potions with a similar temporary effect, increasing damage significantly. Unfortunately, we cannot leave this stat unchanged.

Multiplayer features.
Gladiators: Survival in Rome has been available as a mobile game for some time, and one of the most requested features has always been multiplayer and player interaction. Our main goal is to introduce multiplayer features first and foremost. This year the first iteration of guild basics are going to be introduced: creating, joining and chatting within a guild!

Endgame content.
After and expand endgame content and depth of the RPG elements: Talent Tree System, Equipment Attributed, new biome and main story update is on the horizon as well coming to you in Q2.

Battle System updates.
Later part of the year is going to add daily quests, a battlepass type of system and also active abilities for equipment and new ways to acquire them.

And many many more to come.
